title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: streaming stability + function calls + roles/stop/logprobs + response formatting
author: Priya Natarajan
body: This PR brings Redwood's OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat.completions surface closer to parity with upstream semantics. It addresses four tightly coupled areas: 1) more robust streaming (stability and ordering guarantees for chunked token streams), 2) function/tool calling compatibility (function metadata propagation, call routing, and structured outputs), 3) role handling and stop/logprobs parameters (backwards-compatible behavior for system/user/assistant roles and legacy stop/logprobs flags), and 4) response formatting improvements to match OpenAI's field names and nested structures. Motivation: customers integrating via the OpenAI compatibility layer expect identical behavioral semantics for edge cases (stream interruptions, concurrent tool invocation, stop tokens, and logprobs). This reduces customer friction when migrating and enables test-suite parity against community evals. The change set includes API surface changes, runtime routing fixes, unit + integration tests for streaming and function call flows, and documentation updates for the compatibility guide. Checklist: - [x] Streaming chunks now respect chunk ordering and finalization events - [x] Function call signal is surfaced consistently in both streaming and non-streaming flows - [x] Roles are normalized and role-based token attribution for logprobs restored - [x] stop and logprobs parameters honored with legacy fallbacks - [x] Structured output for function calls follows OpenAI naming ("name", "arguments") - [x] New end-to-end tests added to eval harness - [x] Docs updated with examples and migration notes
commits: feat(api): add streaming finalization events and chunk sequence metadata
fix(runtime): preserve function call boundary when streaming function arguments
test: add integration tests for stop/logprobs behavior with roles
docs: update openai-compat migration guide and examples
review_comments: Ethan Park: The streaming manager change looks good but I'm worried about the memory window for buffered chunks; can we bound it?
Priya Natarajan: Added bounded buffer with sliding window eviction and a configurable env var STREAM_BUFFER_MAX (default 5MB). Updated tests to assert eviction behavior.
Marta Alvarez: Function call propagation tests are flaky on ARM CI; request to add deterministic seed and smaller payloads.
Priya Natarajan: Reduced payloads in test fixtures and added deterministic RNG seed for the router tests; re-ran CI.
Samir Gupta: We should preserve previous stop parameter semantics when stop is provided as string vs list; please add compatibility cases.
Priya Natarajan: Added parsing branch that normalizes stop to list and retains legacy behaviour when stop==null. Added unit tests.
